Pebble Notes

Pebble Notes keeps quick notes, lists and voice memos in one place. Write a note on your phone and it is on your tablet and your computer a moment later. Notes sync across every device you sign in to, and they work offline when you travel, so nothing waits for a signal.

Write fast

Open the app and start typing. There is no folder to pick and no title to think of. Pebble Notes puts the newest note at the top and keeps the rest a swipe away. Lists turn into checklists with one tap, and finished items move to the bottom so the list stays short.

Find anything

Search reads every word in every note, including the words in photos of receipts and whiteboards. Type two letters and the matching notes show up. Pin the notes you open every day, and colour the ones that belong together, like trip plans or recipes for the week.

Voice memos

Hold the microphone button to record a memo. Pebble Notes writes down what you said, so you can search a memo the same way you search a note. Memos stay on your phone until you share them, and you choose who sees each one.

Read the support page for answers about sync, or get Pebble Notes on the App Store.
